overall_reason: The same launch-package screen is shown whole and shrunk, so the package and its download action become small details in a frame of empty tiles.

score.reason: T-SIGNATURE fails: the window is scaled down so the 22px 'Launch package' heading renders at about 14px at 1440 and smaller at 375; T-REMOVE-DEVICE finds the six empty tiles add nothing.

findings.evidence: The full app window (sidebar, main pane, asset pane) is scaled to fit the 540px frame; meta text such as '24 assets · 18.6 MB' renders at about 6px and is unreadable at 375 (tile 375-00.png).
findings.after: Crop to the package card and the 'Download package' button at full size
findings.why: The object the scene is about is too small to read, so the composition says 'an app' instead of 'this package is ready'.

findings.evidence: Six empty #efe8ea tiles fill the right third of the window and stand in for the 24 assets.
findings.after: Remove the pane, or show real asset thumbnails [DATA NEEDED: asset images]
findings.why: Removing them makes the scene clearer, which marks them as filler (T-REMOVE-DEVICE).

strengths: The palette and the single 'Download package' button match a coherent product look.
not_investigated: 00-contract.md is absent: no brand authority, audience or overrides were available, so the item was read as an Operate composition (CON-018).
